chapters.title: Welcome to the RNG-Hellscape
chapters.goal: Artie survives his first encounter and establishes his 1 HP / 100% Crit anomaly status in Oakhaven.
chapters.stakes_shift: From mundane office drone to a high-value system anomaly targeted by a powerful rival.

bridge.from_prev: Artie dies in a vending machine accident and enters the character creation void.
bridge.to_next: Artie must find a way to survive his fragility by acquiring gear that compensates for his 1 HP.

sections.title: Death by Snacking
sections.intent: Establish Artie's mundane life and his absurd death via vending machine.
sections.end_condition: Artie dies from electrocution and enters the Character Creation Void.

scenes.summary: Artie, a hungry accountant, attempts to buy a bag of chips from the office vending machine, but the bag gets stuck.
scenes.outcome: Artie decides to manually retrieve the stuck snack.
scenes.location_start: The breakroom of a mid-sized accounting firm
scenes.location_end: The breakroom of a mid-sized accounting firm
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie’s stomach growls as he walks toward the breakroom vending machine.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie glares at the dangling bag of chips and prepares to intervene.

scenes.summary: Artie tries to shake the machine and eventually reaches into the dispenser flap to dislodge the chips.
scenes.outcome: Artie's hand gets stuck near the internal wiring.
scenes.location_start: The breakroom of a mid-sized accounting firm
scenes.location_end: The breakroom of a mid-sized accounting firm
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie stares at the stuck bag of chips behind the vending machine glass.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie reaches deep into the machine's dispenser flap to shake the snack loose.

scenes.summary: A massive electrical surge from the machine kills Artie instantly, sending his consciousness into the void.
scenes.outcome: Artie dies and enters the Character Creation Void.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie dies from electrocution and enters the Character Creation Void.
scenes.location_start: The breakroom of a mid-sized accounting firm
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie reaches into the machine's dispenser flap to shake the snack loose.
scenes.transition_out_text: The world turns white as the electricity stops Artie's heart.

sections.title: The Grease-Fire Build
sections.intent: Introduce Fizz and the UI glitch that locks Artie into the 1 HP / 100% Crit build.
sections.end_condition: Artie spawns in the tutorial forest with his glitched stats locked.

scenes.summary: Artie meets Fizz, the AI assistant, who explains he has been 'recruited' into the game world.
scenes.outcome: Artie begins the character creation process.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie wakes up in a white expanse of the Character Creation Void.
scenes.transition_out_text: Fizz gestures to the stat allocation panel floating in the void.

scenes.summary: A glitch occurs during stat allocation, locking Artie's HP at 1 and his Critical Hit rate at 100%.
scenes.outcome: Artie is stuck with a glass-cannon build.
scenes.transition_in_text: Fizz gestures to the stat allocation panel floating in the void.
scenes.transition_out_text: The system forces the character confirmation despite the errors.

scenes.summary: The system finalizes the build and teleports Artie into the Tutorial Forest.
scenes.outcome: Artie spawns in the tutorial forest with his glitched stats locked.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie spawns in the tutorial forest with his glitched stats locked.
scenes.transition_in_text: The white void dissolves into the pixelated trees of the Tutorial Forest.
scenes.transition_out_text: The loading bar hits 100% and the forest floor solidifies under Artie's feet.

sections.title: The Participation Trophy
sections.intent: Demonstrate the power of the crit build and introduce the cursed item mechanic.
sections.end_condition: Artie acquires the cursed Participation Trophy after vaporizing a slime.

scenes.summary: Artie encounters his first enemy, a blue slime, and discovers that even a light tap results in a massive crit.
scenes.outcome: Artie kills the slime with a single, absurdly powerful hit.
scenes.transition_in_text: A blue slime bounces into the clearing of the Tutorial Forest.
scenes.transition_out_text: The slime explodes into a shower of loot across the forest floor.

scenes.summary: Artie loots the slime and finds the Participation Trophy, which is cursed and cannot be unequipped.
scenes.outcome: Artie acquires the cursed Participation Trophy after vaporizing a slime.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie acquires the cursed Participation Trophy after vaporizing a slime.
scenes.transition_in_text: The slime explodes into a shower of loot across the forest floor.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie pockets the trophy and heads toward the smoke on the horizon.

sections.title: Oakhaven's Welcome
sections.intent: Introduce the world's RNG obsession and the primary antagonist, Vane.
sections.end_condition: Artie escapes a forced duel with Vane and enters Oakhaven proper.

scenes.summary: Artie is intercepted by Vane, a high-level player who tries to force Artie into a duel for his 'rare' trophy.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes he cannot win a fair fight and looks for an escape.
scenes.transition_in_text: A shadow falls over Artie as he inspects the Participation Trophy.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie sprints toward the city gates as Vane draws his blade.

scenes.summary: Artie uses the chaos of a passing merchant caravan to slip past Vane and enter the safety of Oakhaven.
scenes.outcome: Artie escapes a forced duel with Vane and enters Oakhaven proper.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie escapes a forced duel with Vane and enters Oakhaven proper.
scenes.location_end: The bustling central square of Oakhaven
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie dives through the closing iron gates of Oakhaven.

chapters.title: The Glass Cannon’s Guide to Not Dying
chapters.goal: Artie acquires the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion and begins exploiting the system's loot mechanics in the crypts.
chapters.stakes_shift: From desperate survival to tactical exploitation of the system's physics and drop rates.

bridge.from_prev: Artie escapes Vane but remains a one-hit-kill target.
bridge.to_next: Artie's rapid farming triggers the attention of the Floor Guardian.

sections.title: The Coward's Wardrobe
sections.intent: Artie seeks gear to survive his 1 HP fragility and exploits a quest loophole.
sections.end_condition: Artie steals the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion from a locked starter chest.

scenes.summary: Artie wanders the Oakhaven market looking for defensive gear, but everything is either too expensive or level-locked, leaving him vulnerable.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes standard merchants cannot solve his 1 HP problem.
scenes.location_start: The bustling central square of Oakhaven
scenes.location_end: A row of overpriced armor stalls in the market
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie catches his breath among the crowded market stalls, scanning for armor vendors.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie turns away from the laughing merchant, his empty pockets offering no solutions.

scenes.summary: Fizz points out a 'Starter Quest' loophole involving an allegedly unbreakable display chest meant to teach players about lockpicking.
scenes.outcome: Artie decides to bypass the quest requirements and just break the chest.
scenes.location_start: A row of overpriced armor stalls in the market
scenes.location_end: The crowded plaza in front of the Adventurer's Guild
scenes.transition_in_text: Fizz projects a glowing blue waypoint leading away from the market toward the guild plaza.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps up to the heavy display chest, ignoring the warning signs.

scenes.summary: Artie strikes the 'indestructible' lock, triggering a massive critical hit that shatters it, allowing him to loot the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion.
scenes.outcome: Artie steals the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion from a locked starter chest.
scenes.location_start: The crowded plaza in front of the Adventurer's Guild
scenes.location_end: A shadowed alley behind the guild hall
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie raises his rusty dagger and brings it down hard on the indestructible lock.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie wraps the oversized cloak around his shoulders and ducks into a nearby alley before the guards arrive.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie steals the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion from a locked starter chest.

sections.title: Loot Pinata Theory
sections.intent: Artie enters the crypts and discovers how his crits break the loot drop system.
sections.end_condition: Artie clears a room of skeletons, turning them into a mountain of loot.

scenes.summary: Artie enters the Oakhaven Crypts, testing his new Cloak of the Cowardly Lion to sneak past high-level mobs, but accidentally aggros a skeleton.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes the cloak's stealth is flawed but his 100% crit still applies to basic attacks.
scenes.location_start: A shadowed alley behind the guild hall
scenes.location_end: The damp entrance to the Oakhaven Crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie slips out of the shadowed alleyway, following Fizz's glowing waypoint toward the low-level crypts on the edge of town.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie steps on a brittle femur, drawing the glowing red eyes of a skeletal guard.

scenes.summary: Artie panics and throws a random rock at the skeleton, triggering a massive critical hit that shatters it into an absurd amount of loot.
scenes.outcome: Artie discovers that his crits force enemies to drop their entire loot table at once.
scenes.location_start: The damp entrance to the Oakhaven Crypts
scenes.location_end: A small antechamber inside the crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie scrambles backward across the damp stone as the skeleton lunges, grabbing a loose rock from the floor.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie stares at the mountain of gold coins and rare bone fragments burying the shattered skeleton.

scenes.summary: Realizing the exploit, Artie systematically clears the antechamber by throwing pebbles at a horde of skeletons, creating a massive pile of loot.
scenes.outcome: Artie clears a room of skeletons, turning them into a mountain of loot.
scenes.location_start: A small antechamber inside the crypts
scenes.location_end: A small antechamber inside the crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie scoops up a handful of gravel, eyeing the next group of skeletons with a greedy grin.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie sits atop his new hoard, ignoring the deep rumbling echoing from the lower crypt levels.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie clears a room of skeletons, turning them into a mountain of loot.

sections.title: Summoning Trouble
sections.intent: Vane's interference forces Artie to take a massive risk for XP.
sections.end_condition: Artie activates the Boss Trigger left behind by Vane.

scenes.summary: Artie and Fizz investigate the rumbling deeper in the crypts, discovering that Vane has been clearing the lower levels and left behind a high-level Boss Trigger item to farm later.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes Vane is using the crypts as a personal farming ground and spots the Boss Trigger.
scenes.location_start: A small antechamber inside the crypts
scenes.location_end: A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie slides down the mountain of gold coins, following the deep rumbling sound deeper into the dark stone corridor.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie peers around a shattered stone pillar, spotting the glowing Boss Trigger resting on an obsidian pedestal.

scenes.summary: Fizz warns Artie that activating the Boss Trigger will summon a creature far beyond his level, but Artie calculates the massive XP payout and decides the risk is worth it to out-level Vane's threat.
scenes.outcome: Artie decides to steal Vane's boss kill to gain a massive XP boost.
scenes.location_start: A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts
scenes.location_end: A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Fizz projects a flashing red warning screen over the glowing Boss Trigger, detailing the suicidal level gap.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie dismisses the warning screen with a swipe of his hand, stepping up to the obsidian pedestal.

scenes.summary: Artie ignores Fizz's frantic warnings and slams his hand onto the Boss Trigger, locking the room and initiating the summoning sequence for the Floor Guardian.
scenes.outcome: Artie activates the Boss Trigger left behind by Vane.
scenes.location_start: A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts
scenes.location_end: A massive, circular stone chamber deep in the crypts
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie steps up to the obsidian pedestal, ignoring Fizz's frantic beeping.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie activates the Boss Trigger left behind by Vane.

chapters.title: Math-Boss vs. The Glitch
chapters.goal: Artie defeats the Bone Golem through a physics exploit and reaches Level 10, becoming a recognized threat.
chapters.stakes_shift: From local anomaly to a system-level glitch that threatens the established power hierarchy.

bridge.from_prev: Artie summons the Floor Guardian to maximize his XP gains.
bridge.to_next: Vane's fury over the stolen kill forces Artie to flee toward the capital city.

sections.title: The Un-Crittable Golem
sections.intent: Artie faces a boss that negates his primary advantage.
sections.end_condition: Fizz reveals the Bone Golem has a Crit-Resist aura.

sections.title: Critting the Environment
sections.intent: Artie uses physics exploits to bypass the boss's mechanical defenses.
sections.end_condition: Artie defeats the Golem via a Cosmetic Crit and reaches Level 10.

sections.title: The First Glitch Mural
sections.intent: Establish the deeper lore of the system and the threat of Vane's pursuit.
sections.end_condition: Artie flees the crypts as Vane arrives to find the boss already dead.

chapters.title: The Capital of Crits
chapters.goal: Artie infiltrates the RNG-worshipping capital and enters the Grand Crit-Off to secure the Shield of Infinite Health.
chapters.stakes_shift: From physical survival to a high-stakes social and political gamble against the High Priest's son.

bridge.from_prev: Artie arrives at the capital seeking a way to fix his stats.
bridge.to_next: The tournament begins, forcing Artie to fight in a public arena where his glitch is on full display.

sections.title: The Temple of the D20
sections.intent: Explore the capital's culture and Artie's search for a stat fix.
sections.end_condition: Artie learns that Stat-Wiping is a capital offense.

sections.title: The Lag-Switch Potion
sections.intent: Artie interacts with the underground resistance and gains a temporary glitch tool.
sections.end_condition: Artie escapes a Sentinel raid by using the illegal Lag-Switch potion.

sections.title: High Stakes Entry
sections.intent: Artie commits to the tournament to win the Shield of Infinite Health.
sections.end_condition: Artie registers for the Grand Crit-Off and loses his entire gold reserve to fees.

chapters.title: The Tournament of Tiers
chapters.goal: Artie advances to the finals by weaponizing the system's own glitches against increasingly absurd opponents.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a simple tournament participant to a target of direct System intervention and rigged mechanics.

bridge.from_prev: Artie registers for the tournament and faces his first round of opponents.
bridge.to_next: Vane prepares a System Override scroll to ensure Artie's permanent deletion in the final match.

sections.title: Wardrobe Malfunction
sections.intent: Artie wins his first matches using unconventional crit targets.
sections.end_condition: Artie defeats a heavy tank by critting his belt buckle.

sections.title: Inverted Victory
sections.intent: The System attempts to handicap Artie with random debuffs.
sections.end_condition: Artie wins the quarter-finals while suffering from an Inverted Controls debuff.

sections.title: The Glowing Trophy
sections.intent: The cursed item begins to react to the high-density crit energy in the arena.
sections.end_condition: Artie advances to the finals as the Participation Trophy begins to pulse with dark energy.

chapters.title: The Final Roll
chapters.goal: Artie defeats Vane by critting the system's reflection math and escapes the Administrator's deletion attempt.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a character in a game to a reality-warping virus that the System can no longer control.

bridge.from_prev: The final match begins with Vane holding all the rigged advantages.
bridge.to_next: The world pixelates and Artie is cast into the wireframe Null-Zone.

sections.title: The Rigged Arena
sections.intent: Vane uses his influence to strip Artie of his evasion advantages.
sections.end_condition: Vane activates a System Override scroll to disable Artie's dodge mechanics.

sections.title: Recursive Reflection
sections.intent: Artie must find a way to hit Vane without killing himself on the Reflect armor.
sections.end_condition: Artie lands a meta-crit on the Reflect buff, causing the arena to pixelate.

sections.title: Deleting the Delete Button
sections.intent: The System Administrator intervenes, and Artie must glitch his way out of existence.
sections.end_condition: Artie and Fizz escape into Safe Mode after critting the Admin's UI.

chapters.title: Rebooting for the Sequel
chapters.goal: Artie accepts his new status as a 'NaN' entity and joins the Beta-Testers to take down the Administrator.
chapters.stakes_shift: From surviving the system to actively planning its overthrow as a legendary glitch.

bridge.from_prev: Artie wakes up in the Null-Zone after the arena's collapse.
bridge.to_next: Artie enters the Glitch-Woods, setting the stage for the next book.

sections.title: The NaN Entity
sections.intent: Artie explores his new status as a non-numerical glitch in the Null-Zone.
sections.end_condition: Artie confirms his NaN HP status by surviving a terminal fall.

sections.title: The Beta-Tester Faction
sections.intent: Introduce the allies who will help Artie take down the Administrator.
sections.end_condition: Artie accepts the legendary quest to 'Delete the Admin'.

sections.title: Into the Glitch-Woods
sections.intent: Set the stage for the next book and the escalation of the war against the System.
sections.end_condition: Artie enters the portal to the Glitch-Woods, leaving the tutorial world behind.
